purpose: Machine-readable boundary between a research requirement and an experiment implementation that can produce audited evidence.

planning_constraints: Use primary_method_id as the proposed method and only baseline_method_ids in baselines[].name; include the primary method plus relevant baselines in every primary experiment.
Use only the registered metric_names; express retention as a comparison on qa_token_f1 against uncompressed_context.
Use the preferred LongBench dataset entry exactly as published by this capability profile; do not add a second dataset during this executable validation run.

Describe loss_aware_hierarchical_20pct exactly as the registered deterministic proxy: rank text units by question-token overlap, entity/number salience, and an early-position tie-break, then retain at most 20 percent of source tokens. Do not claim trainable summarization, policy gradients, neural retrieval, or online learning.

The fixed reader returns the text unit with maximum question-token overlap. Treat qa_token_f1 and exact match as proxy evidence for retained answer information, not as generative-LLM QA accuracy or state-of-the-art evidence.
Do not claim BDCI results unless an accessible BDCI evaluation file is actually supplied; use an accessible public long-context QA benchmark and state the scope change.
